help.source: upload (a release folder sent from the Updates screen), github (the latest release of the repository set on that screen) or repository (the apt or dnf repository of Pelagos).
help.auto_rollback_enabled: Only when the release keeps the state schema of the installed one; otherwise the rollout stops and shows the manual procedure.

auth.require_webauthn_roles: Roles that require a security key

checks.custom_hooks_enabled: Warn about Kea hooks no package owns
checks.resolver_drop_min_per_minute: Query drop: minimum queries per minute
checks.resolver_roots_failures: Root probe failures in a row
checks.advisories_fetch_enabled: Fetch advisory data from the network
checks.distro_tracker_enabled: Use the Debian security tracker for distribution fixes
checks.resolver_tld_failures: Failed TLD probes before an alert

collector.live_seconds: Live pass: HA heartbeats and lease watch
collector.lease_watch_max_leases: Lease watch: largest lease table walked

dns.default_ns: Name servers of new primary zones
dns.zone_read_max_names: Largest zone the web interface reads

kea.migration_response_delay_milliseconds: Failure detection delay during the migration
kea.migration_auto_rollback_enabled: Roll back automatically when a check fails during the outage
kea.migration_outage_max_seconds: Longest DHCP outage before an automatic rollback
kea.migration_lease_file_max_mb: Largest lease file copied to the partner

certificates.retry_min_seconds: First retry after a failed request

archives.verify_enabled: Read back and check each copy

ddns.demote_on_return_enabled: Demote the former primary when it returns

resolver.fallback_return_healthy_minutes: Offer the return after healthy probes for

ipv6.neighbors_enabled: Read the neighbor table of each node

auth.session_ttl_seconds: A session ends this long after sign-in, active or not.
auth.login_rate_limit_per_minute: Per client address; more get 429 until the minute ends.
auth.require_totp: Users without TOTP may only enrol until they do.
auth.webauthn_rp_id: auto: the DNS domain the nodes share. Or a domain such as example.lan; keys registered under another domain stop working.
auth.require_webauthn_roles: Members of these roles sign in with a security key; TOTP alone is not enough.
auth.api_token_default_days: Expiry proposed when a token is created.
auth.api_token_audit_reads_enabled: Every call made with a token is audited; off: only writes (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE).

plans.ttl_seconds: A plan not applied within this delay expires.

peers.plan_timeout_seconds: Engine plans applied or rolled back on another node.
peers.installer_plan_timeout_seconds: Install, import and security plans: packages and restarts take longer.
peers.action_timeout_seconds: Plan builds and runtime operations this node asks of another.

checks.pool_warning_percent: Use of a pool that raises pool_near_full; below the critical value.
checks.forecast_window_days: Days of pool samples the trend is computed from.
checks.d2_error_percent: Share of failed DNS updates of kea-dhcp-ddns that raises d2_errors.
checks.update_denied_warning_per_hour: Rejected dynamic updates per hour (over the last day) that raise ddns_advice.
checks.serial_divergence_seconds: A secondary may lag the primary this long before secondary_stale.
checks.ha_grace_seconds: A partner-down or degraded state shorter than this raises nothing (restarts, failovers).
checks.clock_skew_warning_seconds: Also the limit the HA repair plan checks before it restarts HA.
checks.clock_skew_critical_seconds: Kea terminates HA at 60 s: keep it below.
checks.cert_warning_days: Web, node and CA certificates; short-lived ones use a share of their lifetime.
checks.resolver_min_queries: Fewer answers in the window: no resolver alert.
checks.advisories_fetch_enabled: Off: the data shipped with the package, or a file placed by hand.
checks.distro_tracker_enabled: Debian nodes: download the tracker daily (about 14 MB) and keep the BIND and Kea entries. Off or unreachable: upstream versions only.
checks.api_token_warning_days: An alert warns this long before a token expires.
checks.api_token_critical_days: The alert turns critical this long before.

collector.lease_watch_max_leases: Larger tables are not watched live (0 turns the watch off).

dns.view_keys: A view other than _default is reached with its own TSIG key: the update key, and a transfer key when it differs.
dns.default_ttl_seconds: When a record is written without a TTL.
dns.zone_read_max_names: Counted in owner names. A larger zone is refused by the records page, record plans, PTR sync, restore plans and catalog edits (409 zone_too_large), and left out of the hosts and PTR views: the web process stays responsive. Policy (RPZ) and catalog zones are never read there.

rpz.shrink_percent: A download that removes more of a list is refused; the old file stays.
rpz.memory_warning_percent: Estimated share of a node memory the lists may take.

notifications.confirm_seconds: An alert must stay open this long before it is sent; critical alerts are sent at once.
notifications.messages_max_per_hour: Beyond it, one message says how many events were held back.

archives.schedule_enabled: Off until an archive key exists.
archives.stagger_minutes: Each node starts this much later than the previous one.
archives.test_restore_days: Opens the latest archive and checks it with the engine tools (0: never).

ddns.failover_auto_enabled: Off: the outage alert proposes the promotion plan and you confirm it.
ddns.failover_after_seconds: The primary must be unreachable from every other node this long.

resolver.fallback_auto_enabled: Off: the fallback is only proposed by the alerts, with a notification.
resolver.probe_tlds: The TLDs of the zones the cluster serves are probed as well.

ipv6.stable_min_days: Above the 7 day lifetime of a temporary address on Windows and macOS (2 days on Linux, RFC 8981).
ipv6.auto_apply_enabled: Reserved: the first version creates records only by plan.

kea.migration_response_delay_milliseconds: max-response-delay of the standby while it waits to serve alone; restored after the migration.
kea.migration_outage_max_seconds: Past this, the pair goes back to Kea 2.6 when automatic rollback is on.

updates.auto_rollback_enabled: Only when the release keeps the state schema of the installed one; otherwise the rollout stops and shows the manual procedure.
